Record notes

Complete local-first career proof, applications, interviews and outreach, with optional official installed-provider depth and operator-owned Career Atlas and Job Application Compass runtimes.

Version 0.2.0 includes 9 complete skill procedures. Full canonical first-party methods and MIT source packs; official AIHumanizer, CoverLetterWriter and UIUXDesigner methods are receiver-installed.

Requirements: Your real work evidence, target role or exact application prompt, and action-specific authorization; Python 3 on PATH for the optional Career Atlas launcher; Optional Career Atlas: separately installed Activities Templates runtime and recipient-owned approved catalog; Optional Job Application Compass: separately maintained operator-owned private runtime; no public backend bundled; Optional Codex depth methods: aihumanizer@openai-curated-remote, coverletterwriter@openai-curated-remote, uiuxdesigner@openai-curated-remote.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained AI Job Search and LinkedIn Agent MIT grants unchanged as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add career-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from d9102ebae7dc6b9d51049fdb6212d0877e9767d1. SHA-256: 3513e92ced56b4934cfc139733d88dc0d935da43cda4bf55f700253865ec9149.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
